decisions.reason: Having already been publicly introduced and retained once, the hand-knotted wool-silk carpet benefits from accumulated commitment and still fits the firm's craftsmanship and fine-material positioning, so management would likely continue to justify it.

Although low-pile carpets are easier to rationalize in a broad range, this model has survived an earlier review and the withdrawal of other nearby carpet launches makes it easier to defend keeping as the remaining committed option.
The corner bench sits squarely in the firm's core furniture business for residential and project interiors, and prior investment plus public launch make continued support the more likely choice.
The multi-model swivel shell chair line represents the strongest visible commitment and aligns with flexible workplace concepts, so escalation of commitment strongly favors maintaining it.
